lines: Meet amend. A private messenger that grows a forest. amend is built for two things that matter more every year: keeping our conversations private, and taking better care of the planet we share. Let's take a look at how it works.

There is no sign-up. No phone number, no email, and no password. When you open amend for the first time, you simply plant your seed. amend creates a secure key on your phone, and that key is your identity. It never leaves your device. To start chatting, share your amend I D or show your Q R code to a friend.
Every message, photo, voice note and video is end-to-end encrypted before it leaves your phone. Voice and video calls are encrypted too, and they work across countries and mobile networks.

amend doesn't run a central server that holds your chats. Like mycelium linking the trees of a forest, your messages travel through independent relays run by different people. No single company owns your conversations, and the relays can't read them. amend is built on the open Nostr protocol, so your key also works in other Nostr apps.

Now, the forest. Every conversation grows its own shared garden, a plant that you and your friend watch grow together. A tiny tree on each message shows when it was sent, delivered and seen. And every day, amend suggests a small eco challenge, like a four-minute shower or a plant-based lunch. Complete one, and your personal forest grows.

amend is honest about its own impact. It measures every byte it sends and receives, and shows what that costs the planet. Then it helps you offset far more with real actions. The built-in step counter tracks your walking, with a daily goal and a monthly report, and your steps stay on your phone.

amend also reaches into the real world. On the community eco map, you can report rubbish dumps, polluted water, burning, or trees cut down. Neighbours confirm the report, and when the place is cleaned up, everyone involved earns points. Plant a real tree, take a photo, and when two friends verify it, a whole new tree joins your forest.

amend is also built to keep you safe. In danger? Press the power button four times, even when your phone is locked. After a short countdown, your live location is shared, encrypted, only with the people you choose, until you stop it. amend also warns you about heatwaves, heavy rain, rising rivers, storms and unhealthy air near you.

And when the internet goes down, during a flood, a cyclone or a shutdown, the offline mesh lets nearby amend phones pass encrypted messages to each other over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, until they reach your friend or someone who is online.
amend speaks your language. It works in fifteen languages, including English, Bangla, Finnish, Arabic and Hindi. Switch any time in settings, with no restart.

No ads. No tracking. Just private conversations, a growing forest, and a little more care for each other and for the planet. amend is now in testing on Google Play. Join us, and plant your seed today.
